lines.text: Jesus sees a tax collector named Levi at the tax booth, tells him to follow, and Levi leaves everything.
Levi hosts a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of fishermen is there.
The Pharisees and scribes complain to the disciples about eating with sinners, and Jesus says He calls sinners to repentance.
Told that His disciples keep eating and drinking, Jesus says guests will fast when the bridegroom is taken.
Jesus says no one pours new oil into old wineskins, and no one after drinking old wine wants new.
